verdict.rationale: Airbyte's Connector Builder AI Assistant explicitly automates parts of connector creation from API docs, prefilling fields/sections (which can include auth, pagination, stream detection) to reduce manual setup, matching the core of this story. However, the docs describe it as prefilling 'a number of fields' rather than fully drafting a complete, ready-to-ship connector, and there's no independent/hands-on evidence validating end-to-end success on auth+pagination+streams together. missing for 10: independent corroboration of AI-drafted connectors working end-to-end, explicit confirmation that auth/pagination/streams are all auto-generated (not just some fields), and real user reports of shipping AI-built connectors.
